evidence.moatW: 【2026-07-29 v9.9.41再監査 → 50を維持】売上の内訳(10-K FY2025): Direct revenue(有料サブスクリプション Grindr XTRA/Unlimited＋アドオン) 366,297千USD = 83.3% / Indirect revenue(広告) 73,601千USD = 16.7%、総額 439,898千USD。10-K本文でも「we also generate indirect revenue, representing 16.7%, 15.6%, and 13.2% of total revenue for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023」と一致。報告セグメントは1つ(Schedule of Segment Information)。地域別 Domestic 254,300 = 57.8% / International 185,598 = 42.2%だが、v9.9.41追加規約により地域別は独立した堀に数えない。→ 広告(Indirect)は同一アプリの同一ユーザー網を再現金化したもので、10-K自身が「both of which are driven by the Grindr platform」と述べるとおり同一プラットフォームに乗る＝v9.9.41追加規約により1本。その1本の中で Direct が83.3%(≥80%)の単一製品ライン → 50。出典: SEC 10-K FY2025 grnd-20251231.htm (Disaggregation of Revenues / Item 1 Business)
evidence.dom: 【2026-07-29 v9.9.41再監査 → 85から50へ引き下げ】旧dom=85は_meta.evidence.domがnullの『測っていない数字』で、10-K全文にシェアの数値は一切存在しない。自社シェア: 原本に数値開示なし(10-K全文で自社の市場シェア%の記載ゼロ。Average MAU 15.0百万人・Average Paying Users 1.3百万人[FY2025]は自社の規模であって市場全体に対する比率ではない)。上位N社合計シェア: 同じく開示なし。会社の自称は Item 1 の「there are few global platforms that focus solely on the gay, bisexual, transgender, and queer ("GBTQ") community」および「our first mover advantage in the GBTQ social networking industry」だが、これは順位・位置づけの自称であって v9.9.41規約4 によりどの刻みの証拠にもならない。市場構造の記述(Item 1A Risk Factors): 「The online social networking and dating app industries are highly competitive, with a consistent stream of new products and services and entrants, particularly as AI tools have significantly lowered the cost of and barriers to building new digital products. We compete primarily with other global platforms that provide dating and networking products and services that have LGBTQ users, such as Tinder and Hinge; non-dating specific social networking platforms such as Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn; and LGBTQ-focused providers of casual dating, dating, and networking products and services for LGBTQ users, such as Scruff, Sniffies, Feeld, and PlanetRomeo.」「Some of our competitors may enjoy better competitive positions in certain geographical regions, with certain user demographics...」「Potential competitors include larger companies that could devote greater resources...」。=同一用途で競合する事業者を LGBTQ特化4社＋主要ダーティングアプリ2ブランド＋汎用SNS3社と名指しし、参入障壁は低下中で新規参入が続くと明言。複占(上位2社≥80%)・3社寡占(上位3社≥80%)を支える数値も構造も無い。→ 自社シェア=非開示(『参入障壁が低下し新規参入が続く』市場で40%以上は構造上主張できない) / 上位N社合計=非開示・寡占構造に非該当 → v9.9.41規約2(85は数値必須)により85は成立せず、規約3により 刻み50。出典: SEC 10-K FY2025 (Grindr Inc., CIK 1820144) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1820144/000182014426000007/grnd-20251231.htm Item 1 Business / Item 1A Risk Factors(競争の項)
